openings.discriminator: Same-layout switching penalty versus compartment-count complexity.
openings.probe: Both workers: counterbalance repeated/alternating sequences across counts, match color; time four stages separately; audit contents.
openings.uncertainty: Practice, worker differences and sample feasibility; exploratory only.

openings.claim: Order-specific diagrams may clarify short-partition destinations.
openings.discriminator: Fewer placement errors/help requests with identical verified kits.
openings.probe: Randomize ten participants between diagrams; balance layouts; observe unaided completion; cost printing/preparation.
openings.uncertainty: Informational versus physical difficulty; ten cannot validate 90%.

openings.claim: Reusable silhouette/color mats may externalize completeness checking while retaining workshop assembly.
openings.discriminator: Fewer missed errors and shorter checks, especially alternating layouts; downstream errors persist.
openings.probe: Use at most three board samples; alternate matched mat/current checks; time four stages; inspect packed contents.
openings.uncertainty: Template completeness, variant distinguishability, handling overhead and cost.

openings.claim: Marked order-matched flat kits may transfer initial insertion to customers.
openings.discriminator: Insertion savings exceed kitting/marking; placement improves only if ambiguity dominates physical difficulty.
openings.probe: Up to twelve remaining samples, ten participants across layouts: record unaided completion, retries, workshop stages and costs.
openings.uncertainty: Customer acceptance, later rearrangement legibility and protective packaging cost.

decision: Screen within existing resources/deadline; no proven remedy. All require 30x20 cm footprint, same capacity, reversible joints, selected counts/color, initial cost <=500 and recurring addition <=0.40. Reject adoption violating these or erasing time savings. Pilot targets: >=59/60 complete, median <=8 minutes, >=54/60 unaided. Overlapping widths leave insertion cause unresolved; reports incompletely establish packing errors.
